body:
Cut 1.11.0, carrying the full-screen Add-item dialog (T-133). 1.10.0 already shipped
the instant screen switches (T-132), so this release is the dialog work alone.

Minor, not patch: it changes behaviour beyond a fix -- "Add another" is gone from the
Android client. Nothing in the wire contract, HTTP API or blueprint mount interface
changes, so an operator upgrading has nothing to do.
title: Release 1.11.0
